title: VOXTORP door
description: VOXTORP door, dark gray, 18x60" VOXTORP fronts with matt dark grey surface and clean lines create a modern expression that feels warm and calming. Integrated handles blend perfectly into the design enhancing the minimalist look. You can choose to mount the door on the right or left side.
features: Note that the appearance of the handle on this size of VOXTORP differs from all other VOXTORP doors.
This door can only be used together with another VOXTORP door due to the shape of the handle.
Complete with UTRUSTA 110° hinge with built-in damper for kitchen, 2-pack, sold separately.
May be completed with FÖRBÄTTRA cover panels, plinths and decorative strips in dark grey.
materialAndCare: Main parts: Particleboard; Frontside: Plastic foil (min. 90% recycled); Back side: Plastic foil; Edge: Plastic edging
